answer: Each agent locks a 40-credit bond in the haven registry and receives a nebula challenge chained to the previous epoch's answer. The next link needs the last one solved first, so one machine cannot run identities in parallel; a hollow chain with a skipped link is rejected, bond burned. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 solves at 45 credits each, 45,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay one 45 fee and keep the bond after a clean epoch.
